verified_facts.text: The hotel is set along the shore in Muscat's diplomatic quarter and offers direct beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set along the shore in Muscat’s diplomatic quarter, our five-star urban resort offers direct beach access

verified_facts.text: The hotel has 20 acres of gardens, with the Hajar Mountains rising in the distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sea breeze drifts through 20 acres of gardens, and the Hajar Mountains rise in the distance.

verified_facts.text: The scent of frankincense lingers in the air as guests step inside.
verified_facts.excerpt: As you step inside, the scent of frankincense lingers in the air

verified_facts.text: Qurum Beach, with soft golden sand meeting the Arabian Sea, lies right outside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Qurum Beach is the first thing you notice when you step out of our hotel, soft golden sand meeting the Arabian Sea in one long, open stretch.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is moments from the Royal Opera House and Mutrah Souk.
verified_facts.excerpt: Moments from the Royal Opera House and Mutrah Souk

verified_facts.text: Rooms overlook the Sea of Oman, the Hajar Mountains, or lush greenery with pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our rooms in Muscat overlook the Sea of Oman, the Hajar Mountains, and lush greenery with glistening pools

verified_facts.text: Classic rooms have French windows and private balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience refined comfort in our classic rooms, featuring elegant furnishings, French windows, and private balconies.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite has a living room, two bedrooms and sea-facing views, and connects to a Junior Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Suite, featuring a spacious living room, two elegantly appointed bedrooms, and stunning sea facing views. With a king size master bedroom, twin bedroom, and connection to a Junior Suite

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Suite has a separate living room, a king-size bedroom and floor-to-ceiling Arabian Sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring a separate living room, elegant bedroom with a king size bed, and breathtaking floor to ceiling Arabian Sea views

verified_facts.text: Palm Beach Club has a sauna, floodlit tennis and padel courts, lagoon-style pools and beachside access.
verified_facts.excerpt: unwind in the sauna, or enjoy a friendly match on the floodlit tennis and padel courts. Relax by the lagoon style pools or stroll along the sandy shore with beachside access.

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Massage Suites include a Single Suite and a Couples Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Luxury Massage Suites offer a Single Suite for those who want the hour to themselves, and a Couples Suite for those who prefer to share.

verified_facts.text: The massage suites overlook gardens and have an open sit-out after treatment.
verified_facts.excerpt: massage suites overlooking gardens, with an open sit-out after treatment

verified_facts.text: The Palm Beach Club kids program includes group games, face painting, arts and crafts, movie screenings and age-appropriate video games.
verified_facts.excerpt: From lively group games and magical face painting to hands on arts and crafts, our kids program is full of fun and creativity. Little guests can also enjoy cozy movie screenings and age appropriate video games

verified_facts.text: Trader Vic's has been at the hotel since 2000, set by Qurum Beach with views of the Sea of Oman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 2000, Trader Vics has been a top dining destination in Muscat, set by Qurum Beach with views of the Sea of Oman.

verified_facts.text: Mynah's Edge serves Arabic cuisine in the open air beside the Sea of Oman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine under the stars at Mynahs Edge, where the bold flavors of authentic Arabic cuisine unfold beside the shimmering Sea of Oman.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's concierge team is a Clefs d'Or concierge team that guides guests to souks and coastal paths.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Clefs d'or Concierge Team pairs cultural depth with local flair, tracing routes through living souks, hidden coastal paths

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is spacious and daylight-filled.
verified_facts.excerpt: Keep the session going at our spacious, daylight-filled fitness centre.

verified_facts.text: Signature touches include Omani coffee at reception, a pillow menu and Byredo toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Omani coffee at reception
- Pillow menu
- In Room Tea and Coffee and Espresso machine
- Byredo Toiletries

verified_facts.text: Club InterContinental stays include daily breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails at Trader Vic's.
verified_facts.excerpt: A welcome drink on arrival, daily breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening cocktails at Trader Vic's anchor each Club InterContinental stay

verified_facts.text: The hotel is Green Key certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a proud Green Key certified hotel
